missions.name: Demonic Offering
missions.description: Hunt down cursed relics forged in dragon fire and devil steel to complete this dark offering.

missions.name: Warrior's Arsenal
missions.description: Bring back battle-worn weapons and armor from fallen warriors and hunters across the land.

missions.name: Relics of Old
missions.description: Deliver ancient weapons of dragon bone and battle-forged steel to prove your combat prowess.

missions.name: Frostbound Regalia
missions.description: Collect the frost-forged garments and arcane tomes hidden within the glacier's icy depths.

missions.name: Molten Regalia
missions.description: Retrieve the molten regalia of the Magma set, forged deep within the burning core of the earth.

missions.name: Earthen Ward
missions.description: Gather the earthbound relics of the Terra set, blessed by the stone spirits of the wilds.

missions.name: Storm's Wrath
missions.description: Seize the storm-charged pieces of the Lightning set, crackling with raw elemental energy.

missions.name: Foreign Steel
missions.description: Bring together gear from distant lands, from knightly steel to the exotic craft of Zaoan.

missions.name: Crown of Nobility
missions.description: Assemble the regal pieces of the Crown set, symbols of nobility and battlefield authority.

missions.name: Shield Wall
missions.description: Recover legendary shields from across the realm, each forged to withstand the fiercest of blows.

elements.name: Physical
elements.description: Increases all physical damage from melee attacks and physical spells.

elements.name: Energy
elements.description: Increases damage from energy spells like Thunderstorm and Energy Beam.

elements.name: Earth
elements.description: Increases damage from earth spells like Stone Shower and Terra Strike.

elements.name: Fire
elements.description: Increases damage from fire spells like Great Fireball and Fire Wave.

elements.name: Ice
elements.description: Increases damage from ice spells, runes and imbuements like Avalanche and Ice Wave.

elements.name: Holy
elements.description: Increases damage from holy spells like Divine Missile and Holy Flash.

elements.name: Death
elements.description: Increases damage from death spells like Sudden Death and Death Strike.
